title: Make a controller route
summary: NestJS: Make a controller route. Change the message.
introduction: A controller holds request handlers. @Get maps GET /hello to its method.
learningObjectives: Make a controller route with NestJS

blocks.text: Create a practice project with npx @nestjs/cli new school. Replace src/main.ts with one complete example and run npm run start. Use http://127.0.0.1:3000. The original app files are unused by these small examples.

blocks.title: Make a controller route

blocks.text: The module lists the controller. The Get decorator maps hello to /hello and Nest sends its returned string.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A controller must be listed in a module to be used.
